name: aws-drawio-diagram
description: Editable draw.io (.drawio) files you open and modify in diagrams.net — an editable file, not a finished image (for a ready-to-embed picture, use aws-diagram-design). AWS architecture diagrams from draw.io's official icon stencils, with a verified stencil catalog regenerated from draw.io sources, two-pattern icon rule, layout conventions, templates, validator, and SVG fallback for icons draw.io lacks.
